test_overview: Evaluated a full-game multiplayer Monopoly regression test against the seeded app on localhost:8000 (Game ID 0f8e77a6, GM/master view plus two player contexts for Alice and Bob). Steps 1-8 all passed in full: lobby/players-join flow with per-player join URLs and a Start control disabled until both players connected; game start and initial state (both players at GO with $500, no properties, Alice first); deterministic dice sequence from DICE_MOVES with the JAIL skip correctly NOT consuming a dice value (Turn 4 used 5, not 2); TAX charged exactly $200; GO payout +$200 exactly once per pass; buy/pass flows with correct cash deltas and ownership; rent ($20/$40) paid to owners; landing on own property paying no rent; turn enforcement (controls disabled for non-current player); and real-time cross-client sync without refresh (all non-fatal sync checks passed, no manual refresh ever needed). Step 9 (bankruptcy + game over) correctly triggered: Alice rolled 1 to TAX with only $120 vs $200 due, log confirmed 'Alice is BANKRUPT ... eliminated. Released properties: p6, p1, p3', and both contexts transitioned in real-time to a Game Over view showing 'Bob Wins!', Final Cash $680, standings Bob Active/Properties:1/$680 (Cedar Lane) and Alice Eliminated/Properties:0/$0 - all fatal verifications passed. However, the non-fatal 'Start New Game' option was absent: the Game Over view in both contexts contains zero interactive controls (no button or link of any kind). Per the scoring rules, a failed non-fatal verification results in 0 points for the step. Final score: 49/60.

steps.description: test_setup_and_players_join: Lobby created with players 'Alice' then 'Bob' both listed, each with a unique join URL. Both initially shown 'Waiting…' (not yet connected). Start Game control disabled before both joined; attempted start did not begin the game and lobby state unchanged. Alice and Bob joined via their URLs in separate contexts; GM lobby updated to 'Connected' (real-time, non-fatal check passed) and Start Game became usable. All verifications passed (7/7).

test_start_game_and_initial_state: GM started game; Alice's context showed gameplay UI in real-time with Alice's turn, both players at position 0 (GO), $500 each, no properties owned. Bob's context synced in real-time (non-fatal check passed - no refresh needed). Turn enforcement: Bob's roll control disabled while it was Alice's turn. All verifications passed (5/5).

test_turn1_jail_and_turn2_buy: Turn 1 Alice rolled 3, GO->JAIL(3), cash stayed $500, Skip-Next-Turn flag set, turn->Bob; Bob context synced real-time (non-fatal passed). Turn 2 Bob rolled 6, landed Cedar Lane(6), bought for $160, cash $500->$340, 'Owner: Bob' shown on space 6, turn->Alice; Alice context synced real-time (non-fatal passed). All verifications passed (6/6).

test_turn3_alice_skip_and_turn4_bob_passes_go: Turn 3: Alice's JAIL skip (required clicking roll - acceptable per plan 'brief interaction'); log 'Alice is stuck in JAIL and skips this turn', pos stayed 3, $500, skip flag cleared, turn->Bob. Turn 4 KEY CHECK PASSED: skipped turn consumed NO dice - log 'Bob rolled a 5' (third DICE_MOVES value, not fourth=2). Bob moved p4(6)->Maple Street(1), passed GO exactly once +$200 ($340->$540), passed on purchase (cash stayed $540, space-1 unowned), turn->Alice. All verifications passed (7/7).

test_turn5_tax_and_turn6_pass: Turn 5 Alice rolled 2, JAIL(3)->TAX(5), log 'Alice paid $200 in taxes to the bank', cash $500->$300. Turn 6 Bob rolled 3, Maple Street(1)->Pine Road(4), passed on purchase: cash stayed $540, Pine Road space-4 unowned, turn->Alice. All verifications passed (5/5).

test_turn7_buy_and_turn8_rent: Turn 7 Alice rolled 4, TAX(5)->Elm Place(9), bought for $200, cash $300->$100, 'Owner: Alice' on space 9. Turn 8 Bob rolled 5, Pine Road(4)->Elm Place(9) owned by Alice, log 'Bob paid $40 rent to Alice', Bob cash $540->$500, Alice cash $100->$140. Non-fatal sync: both contexts showed identical post-rent cash ($140/$500) without refresh. All verifications passed (6/6).

test_turn9_go_and_buy_and_turn10_go_and_rent: Turn 9 Alice rolled 2, Elm Place(9)->Maple Street(1) passing GO exactly once +$200 ($140->$340), bought Maple Street for $100 ($340->$240), owns p1+p6 ('Owner: Alice' on space-1). Turn 10 Bob rolled 2, Elm Place(9)->Maple Street(1) passing GO exactly once +$200 ($500->$700), log 'Bob paid $20 rent to Alice for Maple Street', Bob cash $700->$680, Alice cash $240->$260. All verifications passed (8/8).

test_turn11_buy_and_turn12_own_property: Turn 11 Alice rolled 3, Maple Street(1)->Pine Road(4), bought for $140, cash $260->$120, owns p1+p3+p6, 'Owner: Alice' on space-4. Turn 12 Bob rolled 5, Maple Street(1)->Cedar Lane(6) own property - log 'Bob already owns Cedar Lane — no action needed', no rent, cash remained $680. All verifications passed (5/5).

test_turn13_bankruptcy_and_game_over: Turn 13 Alice rolled 1, Pine Road(4)->TAX(5), $200 due vs only $120 -> bankruptcy. Log 'Alice is BANKRUPT (unable to pay $200 in taxes) and has been eliminated. Released properties: p6, p1, p3.' Both contexts transitioned in real-time (non-fatal sync passed) to Game Over view: 'Bob Wins!', Final Cash $680; standings Bob Active/Properties:1/$680 (Cedar Lane) and Alice Eliminated/Properties:0/$0 - all FATAL verifications passed. NON-FATAL FAILURE: no 'Start New Game' option exists - the Game Over view in BOTH contexts contains zero buttons/links (verified ALL button/link elements: [] empty in both contexts). Per scoring rules, this failed non-fatal check marks the step failed (0 points).
